speaker: Unknown
en: Starting a company is a roller coaster.
zh: 创办公司就像坐过山车。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there's like low lows and there are high highs.
zh: 有低谷中的低谷,也有高峰中的高峰。

speaker: Unknown
en: And my view is that you should just ride the roller coaster.
zh: 我的看法是,你就该直接坐上这趟过山车。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like people try to mitigate it, but just ride it and try to have fun.
zh: 人们总想缓解这种起伏,但就直接坐上去,试着享受乐趣吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Please welcome Eric Landau, who is the co-founder of Anchored, who is building the data layer for physical AI, right?
zh: 欢迎Eric Landau,他是Anchored的联合创始人,这家公司在为物理AI构建数据层,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Yep.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Welcome, Eric.
zh: 欢迎你,Eric。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thanks for having me.
zh: 感谢邀请我。

speaker: Unknown
en: So as I was preparing the chat and looking at your background, I was actually pretty surprised.
zh: 我在准备这次聊天、看你的背景时,其实挺惊讶的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's kind of very surprising that you did big data particle physics and then you became a quant for 10 years before creating Anchored.
zh: 你先是做大数据粒子物理,然后在创办Anchored之前做了10年量化交易员,这确实非常出人意料。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, lead us through that.
zh: 好,带我们走一遍吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why?
zh: 为什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: Is there a common thread here?
zh: 这里面有共同的主线吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, the common thread is almost the kind of trajectory of AI development in the time that I've had in my career.
zh: 有,这条主线几乎就是我职业生涯这段时间里AI发展轨迹本身。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's quite interesting because do you know the bitter lesson?
zh: 所以这很有意思,你知道苦涩的教训(the bitter lesson)吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: The bitter lesson is this idea that AI, you know, it used to be that to build an AI system, you would think very carefully about it.
zh: 苦涩的教训是这样一个理念:AI,你知道,过去要构建一个AI系统,你会非常仔细地思考它。

speaker: Unknown
en: You would do all the feature engineering.
zh: 你会做所有的特征工程。

speaker: Unknown
en: You try to induce as much domain expertise into the system before kind of wrapping up in machine learning.
zh: 你会在把系统包裹进机器学习之前,尽量把领域专业知识灌输进系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they found that actually it's better to not do any of that and just to scale the system, just add more data, more compute into it.
zh: 而人们发现,实际上不做那些反而更好,直接扩展系统就行,就是往里面加更多数据、更多算力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when I started in physics, I was doing particle physics.
zh: 当我开始做物理时,我做的是粒子物理。

speaker: Unknown
en: The systems and the strategy was based off of the physics itself.
zh: 系统和策略都是基于物理本身。

speaker: Unknown
en: You'd filter the data based off the way the particles were moving, the momentum.
zh: 你会根据粒子运动的方式、动量来过滤数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then in high-frequency trading, it was thinking about the market, what factors actually move the market one way or the other, and then really crafting that and then putting it together into machine learning model afterwards.
zh: 然后到了高频交易,就是思考市场,思考哪些因素真正推动市场往这个方向或那个方向走,然后精心打磨这些,之后再把它组装进机器学习模型里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, it's just throwing data into a big pile of machine learning and then seeing it- Hoping for the best.
zh: 现在,就是把数据扔进一大堆机器学习里,然后看它—— 盼着最好的结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: Excellent.
zh: 非常好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Before, speaking about Anchored, I realized we were like chatting quickly yesterday about that, right?
zh: 在聊Anchored之前,我记得我们昨天还快速聊过这个,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, that was not the best ideal bet to become wealthy.
zh: 我是说,那不是致富的理想赌注。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, you've been 10 years as a quant.
zh: 我是说,你做了10年量化交易员。

speaker: Unknown
en: I guess you were making way more money as a quant than you did as a founder.
zh: 我猜你做量化赚的钱比做创始人多得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is that right?
zh: 是这样吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in fact, when I quit, I quit during COVID and everything just got, I quit to go start a company.
zh: 而且实际上,我辞职是在COVID期间,一切都变得——我辞职是为了去创办一家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that month,
zh: 而那个月,

speaker: Unknown
en: The market went absolutely crazy.
zh: 市场彻底疯了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was the month where oil was trading negative, extreme high volatility.
zh: 就是原油交易价格变成负数的那个月,极端高波动。

speaker: Unknown
en: People were making a lot of money on WallStreetBets.
zh: 人们在WallStreetBets上赚了大钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: My desk made more money in that month than I think they made in the previous three years combined.
zh: 我所在的那个台那个月赚的钱,我想比之前三年加起来还多。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I had just quit, and I was sitting on my couch fighting Python dependencies in a machine learning library, and I was like, what have I done?
zh: 所以我刚辞职,坐在自家沙发上和某个机器学习库的Python依赖搏斗,我心想,我都干了些什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: But obviously, I didn't do it for the money.
zh: 但显然,我做这个不是为了钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, you left a lot of money on the table.
zh: 是啊,你放弃了很多钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, you didn't know you left as much as that.
zh: 嗯,你当时并不知道放弃了那么多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so what did you do?
zh: 那你当时做了什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: What led you to actually quit a very well-paying job to become a founder?
zh: 是什么让你真的辞掉一份薪水很高的工作去成为创始人?

speaker: Unknown
en: My co-founder and I really believed in AI, and to us it felt like this was the
zh: 我和我的联合创始人真心相信AI,对我们来说,感觉这就是

speaker: Unknown
en: technological paradigm shift of our generation.
zh: 我们这代人的技术范式转变。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was the early days of the internet.
zh: 这就像互联网的早期。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was the early days of computing.
zh: 这就像计算机的早期。

speaker: Unknown
en: And whenever I was a quant for quite some time, and for the last several years, when I would go to sleep at night, I would like hit my head on the pillow and I would think...
zh: 每当我做了相当长时间的量化交易员之后,在过去那几年里,当我晚上睡觉时,我会把头撞在枕头上,然后想……

speaker: Unknown
en: What am I doing with my life?
zh: 我这辈子到底在干什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: And when I started a company, even when all the craziness happened in the markets, I would go to sleep at night and just think about the problems of the company.
zh: 而当我创办公司之后，即使市场上发生了所有那些疯狂的事情，我晚上也能安然入睡，只是想着公司的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wouldn't have the existential fear anymore.
zh: 我不再有那种生存层面的恐惧了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was all like more very concrete ones.
zh: 更多都是非常具体的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: What we were doing actually was providing value to someone.
zh: 因为我们做的事情实际上是在为某些人提供价值。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, they did that first.
zh: 嗯，他们先做了那件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, it doesn't at first, but you believe you're part of something which is bigger than you, and it's very rewarding.
zh: 不，起初并不会，但你相信自己是某个比你更大的事物的一部分，这是非常有回报的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's extremely rewarding to be in a company and seeing it grow and seeing the impact that it can have.
zh: 身处一家公司，看着它成长，看着它能产生的影响，这是极其有回报的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we're in 2021.
zh: 那么我们到了 2021 年。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's when you created Anchor, right?
zh: 那是你创建 Anchor 的时候，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: How long did it take for you to be convinced that there was something here?
zh: 你花了多长时间才确信这里面有些东西？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like the early years were not that easy, right?
zh: 早期那些年并不那么容易，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: No, we were in the desert for a couple of years.
zh: 是的，我们在沙漠里待了几年。

speaker: Unknown
en: So... What made you continue and not give up?
zh: 那么……是什么让你坚持下去而没有放弃？

speaker: Unknown
en: Or pivot?
zh: 或者转型？

speaker: Unknown
en: No, we still believed in AI.
zh: 不，我们仍然相信 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you look in the long horizon, the power of the technology, the generalizability of it.
zh: 而且如果你放长线看，这项技术的力量，它的通用性。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it was hard to convince people that it was as important as it was.
zh: 但要说服人们相信它像实际上那么重要，是很难的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then ChatGPT happened and the kind of tenor of the conversation changed, which definitely helped us quite a bit.
zh: 然后 ChatGPT 出现了，对话的基调变了，这确实帮了我们不少。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did the ChatGPT release actually unlock the market?
zh: ChatGPT 的发布实际上解锁了市场吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Is that because people needed more data or because people starting to realize that AI was important?
zh: 是因为人们需要更多数据，还是因为人们开始意识到 AI 很重要？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, it was more they were open to the conversation.
zh: 是的，更多是他们愿意倾听了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's funny because product market fit for some folks, it's...
zh: 这很有意思，因为对某些人来说，产品市场契合是……

speaker: Unknown
en: So product market fit is both product and market, and these things have to come together.
zh: 产品市场契合既是产品也是市场，这两者必须结合到一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so some people, they achieve product market fit by setting a market constant and then compounding their product to hit that market.
zh: 所以有些人，他们通过把市场设为常量，然后不断打磨产品去命中那个市场，来实现产品市场契合。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sometimes it's the market comes to the product, you know, the world changes and suddenly the thing that people didn't care about now care about.
zh: 有时是市场走向产品，你知道的，世界变了，突然人们开始在乎之前不在乎的东西了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But most cases, it's them kind of both moving in the same direction.
zh: 但大多数情况下，是两者朝着同一个方向共同移动。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for us, our product was just continuously getting better and better and better.
zh: 对我们来说，我们的产品只是一直在变得越来越好越来越好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then after ChatGPT, I wouldn't say there was like a big binary threshold change, but the market started coming to us faster than it was before.
zh: 然后 ChatGPT 之后，我不认为有一个巨大的二元阈值式的变化，但市场开始比以前更快地走向我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so a lot of people, a lot of companies, you talk to them, they did a product launch, they changed their product, and then they suddenly felt immense product market fit.
zh: 所以很多人、很多公司，你和他们聊，他们做了一次产品发布，改变了他们的产品，然后突然感到了强烈的产品市场契合。

speaker: Unknown
en: That never happened to us.
zh: 这种事从未发生在我们身上。

speaker: Unknown
en: It just felt like it was a little bit better every day.
zh: 只是感觉每天都好那么一点点。

speaker: Unknown
en: It just kind of was slowly, slowly compounding.
zh: 就是慢慢地、慢慢地复利式积累。

speaker: Unknown
en: And looking back on it, my co-founder, he thinks the time when we had product market fit was when we saw a sale close in the Gong Channel, and we didn't know what the company did.
zh: 回头看，我的联合创始人认为，我们拥有产品市场契合的时刻，是当我们在 Gong 渠道看到一单成交，而我们不知道那家公司是做什么的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like, what is this company?
zh: 就是说，这家公司是干嘛的？

speaker: Unknown
en: And that was very satisfying because we were doing all the sales ourselves.
zh: 那非常令人满足，因为我们当时所有销售都是自己做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were like intensely involved in every single part of every company that we were trying to sell to.
zh: 我们深度参与到每一个我们试图售卖的公司的每一个环节。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when you see something, they're giving you money, you don't know what they do, that's like, oh, we made it.
zh: 当你看到有公司给你钱，而你不知道他们是做什么的，那就是，哦，我们成功了。

speaker: Unknown
en: You were not involved in that sale.
zh: 你没有参与那笔销售。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is that what you mean?
zh: 你是这个意思吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: When was that?
zh: 那是什么时候？

speaker: Unknown
en: Two months ago.
zh: 两个月前。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, it was some years ago.
zh: 不，那是几年前了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it was only looking back.
zh: 但那只是回头看才意识到的。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was never a single moment where like, oh, we have got product market fit.
zh: 从来没有某一个时刻是，哦，我们获得产品市场契合了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, it's kind of like actually one of the topics here about, I mean, you were kind of a physicist and you had to build a sales org at some point.
zh: 我是说，这其实有点像这里的一个话题，我是说，你本来是个物理学家，然后在某个时候你不得不建立一个销售组织。

speaker: Unknown
en: How were you able to do that?
zh: 你是怎么做到的？

speaker: Unknown
en: How did you hire the first salespeople and when?
zh: 你是怎么招到第一批销售人员的，是在什么时候？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, it was, I wish we had a more elegant answer to this, but it was trial and error.
zh: 是的,真希望我们有一个更优雅的答案,但那就是反复试错。

speaker: Unknown
en: How many did you have to fire?
zh: 你们开除过多少人?

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, so we had a, we brought in a sales team, it didn't work.
zh: 是这样,我们组建过一个销售团队,没成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: We brought another sales team, it didn't work.
zh: 又组建了另一个销售团队,还是没成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: By the third sales team, it started to work.
zh: 到第三个销售团队,才开始奏效。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's funny because, you know, the advice that they give you in YC, it's one of the things that we found is like, it's almost always right.
zh: 而且很有意思的是,你知道,YC 给你的那些建议,我们发现,几乎总是对的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The advice of YC is always right.
zh: YC 的建议总是对的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, no, it's almost always right, but you still make the mistake.
zh: 对,不,它几乎总是对的,但你还是会犯那个错。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember very distinctly, there's a particular hire that we were about to make, or actually we made, and we talked to you, this was maybe a couple years after we had finished with YC, and you said, oh, for this role, you should hire, you should look out for this and this and this, and don't do this and this and this.
zh: 我记得非常清楚,有一个我们正要录用的招聘,或者说其实已经录用了,我们和你聊过,那大概是 YC 结束后的一两年,你说,哦,对于这个职位,你应该注意这个、这个、这个,别做这个、这个、这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're like, oh no.
zh: 我们当时的反应是,哦不。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because we had just hired exactly what you said not to hire.
zh: 因为我们刚刚录用的恰恰就是你说的不该录的那种人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we realized, oh, we made a big mistake.
zh: 我们意识到,哦,我们犯了个大错。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we still brought them on.
zh: 但我们还是让他入职了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we had to learn that it wasn't a fit.
zh: 我们后来才学到,他确实不合适。

speaker: Unknown
en: We should just cut it there.
zh: 我们本该在那里就止步。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we wanted to keep them?
zh: 但我们当时想留住他?

speaker: Unknown
en: That one was, I think, probably nine months.
zh: 那一个,我记得,大概持续了九个月。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's OK.
zh: 那还行。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then, oh, nine months.
zh: 然后是,哦,九个月。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, not nine days or nine weeks.
zh: 好吧,不是九天也不是九周。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've gotten a lot more efficient at learnings here, but yeah, this was something that we learned the hard way.
zh: 我们现在在这方面的学习效率高多了,但这确实是我们吃过的苦头。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right.
zh: 对。

speaker: Unknown
en: So most of you are not there yet.
zh: 你们大多数人还没到那一步。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, there is no world in which you keep someone nine months that you know is bad.
zh: 嗯,没有任何一个世界是你明知道某人不行还留他九个月的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, and it's never, the thing is, it's never, sometimes it's like bad.
zh: 对,而且它从来不是,问题是,它从来不是,有时候是那种很糟的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like, oh man, this is bad.
zh: 就是,哦天哪,这太糟了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But usually it's one of those things where you kind of know in your gut, or you know, you have the feeling, but it's just difficult.
zh: 但通常是你心里其实有点数,或者你知道,你有那种感觉,只是很难。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's never a strong, there's never a strong reason.
zh: 而且从来没有一个强的,从来没有什么强有力的理由。

speaker: Unknown
en: You just know, uh, it's probably not a fit, but there's nothing that pushes you to it.
zh: 你只是知道,呃,他可能不合适,但没有任何东西推你下决心。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what we've gotten a lot better at over the years is just following your gut and making the right decision faster.
zh: 这些年我们进步最大的一点,就是跟着直觉走,更快地做出正确的决定。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, I cannot emphasize that more.
zh: 对,这一点我再怎么强调都不为过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's go back to the product now, because you didn't start with physical AI.
zh: 我们回到产品吧,因为你们并不是从物理 AI 起步的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Physical AI is kind of like the, it felt, it feels like you've built it a few times, still always around data for AI, but the target applications have changed over time, right?
zh: 物理 AI 有点像那种,感觉上,感觉上你们已经把它搭过好几次了,始终围绕 AI 的数据,但目标应用一直在变,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: What did you start with?
zh: 你们最初是从什么开始的?

speaker: Unknown
en: Was that healthcare?
zh: 是医疗健康吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, we started in vision.
zh: 对,我们是从视觉起步的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And our thesis originally started with vision was it was the hardest modality to start with.
zh: 我们最初的论点是,从视觉入手是最难的模态。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we always wanted to be multimodal.
zh: 所以我们一直都想做多模态。

speaker: Unknown
en: And because our thesis was that AI systems would be multimodal naturally.
zh: 因为我们的论点是,AI 系统天然会是多模态的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because humans are multimodal, the best way that you make the best decisions is to take as many sensory inputs as you can accept.
zh: 因为人是多模态的,你做出最佳决策的最好方式,就是尽可能多地接收各种感官输入。

speaker: Unknown
en: So vision was a very dense data type.
zh: 所以视觉是一种非常稠密的数据类型。

speaker: Unknown
en: We developed a lot of expertise into it.
zh: 我们在这方面积累了大量专业能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we moved into multimodality.
zh: 然后我们转向了多模态。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what happened with physical AI is that
zh: 而物理 AI 的情况是,

speaker: Unknown
en: That's one of those cases of your product goes up and the market comes down.
zh: 那就是那种你的产品往上走、市场往下迎的例子。

speaker: Unknown
en: The market started really coming in our direction.
zh: 市场开始真正朝我们的方向走来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the biggest application of multimodal AI now is in physical AI.
zh: 而现在多模态 AI 最大的应用就在物理 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: So now we work in a lot of robotics, autonomous vehicles, logistics, manufacturing.
zh: 所以现在我们在机器人、自动驾驶、物流、制造等领域做了很多工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we started in other use cases which were less popular now.

en: That's okay.

en: Whenever you're high, you know a low is coming and just accept.

en: That you're on a rollercoaster.

en: Run at the fire because it's exciting.

en: That's interesting.
